scope: Localized static review of the corrected same-site diagnostic literal, pinned genuine Cloud provider guard, and audit complete-matrix checks.
basis: The same-site expected message now includes the reported `error:` prefix and parenthesized condition text; the matcher still requires one diagnostic at the unique final-select source line/range and rejects decoy, wrong-site, and duplicate lines. Callee-control classifications remain TARGET_UNPINNED in the pinned proof helper and cannot complete proof rows.

The entry loads provider.py by its exact pin and calls require_supported_provider before the capture or proof callbacks. That pinned module requires a genuine identified Ubuntu 22.04 Cloud Build and the entry additionally requires the returned provider label to be cloud-build. The provider identity is recorded with the helper/pin dependencies.

The audit now requires the exact eight row names/order, complete statuses, expected classes and exit polarity, source-intact and gate summary flags, and complete pre/post captures. It keeps acceptance and proof-credit fields false. However, its own synthetic complete-matrix fixture demonstrates that these summary checks still accept unbound and currently unpinned rows, detailed below.

findings.finding: The audit can report evidence_complete for a matrix that the exact pinned proof helper cannot produce: it accepts EXPECTED_CALLEE_CONTRACT_REJECTION rows even though no callee diagnostic targets are pinned and the helper deliberately emits TARGET_UNPINNED for all four callee negatives. The test's synthetic complete matrix assigns these expected classes without any target-pin manifest or diagnostic record.
findings.impact: The known current limitation that the matrix cannot complete is not enforced by the audit; a fabricated or stale record can overstate evidence completeness despite the no-target-pin boundary.
findings.suggestion: Until exact callee diagnostic targets are independently pinned in a reviewed manifest, make complete_matrix reject all callee expected classes (or require and validate that manifest and per-row target evidence). Update the synthetic fixture so the current unpinned matrix is necessarily incomplete.

findings.finding: complete_matrix checks only the row-level normal_unwind_nested_drop_gates summary. It does not check that the underlying stage has intrinsic_gate_active and pointer_drop_gate_active set true, or bind stage source_before/source_after/source_unchanged, argv, and stdout/stderr to the expected case. The test's supposedly complete stage contains only status and exit, yet passes when summary flags are true.
findings.impact: A partial or stage-target-mismatched row can be reported as evidence-complete by supplying summary booleans and expected classifications, without the stage metadata that establishes the actual gated invocation.
findings.suggestion: Validate the stage gate bits directly and require exact argv/log targets, source-before/after pairs, source_unchanged, and a matching bound_verdict (or otherwise explicitly scope audit completeness to trusted helper-generated records and verify the helper identity). Add malformed-stage and false-gate controls.

validation.synthetic_tests: PACKET-REPORTED 10 classifier + 7 entry + 2 audit PASS; not executed

limitations: NO_GO applies to relying on this audit's evidence_complete result until the unpinned-class and stage-binding gaps are closed. The entry remains inactive, and this review establishes no verifier result, fractional proof validity, acceptance, or proof credit.

findings: The audit now requires both stage gate bits and source_unchanged to be true. CALLEE_TARGETS is explicitly empty, and every callee-control row is rejected until exact diagnostic targets are admitted; the prior synthetic eight-row fixture now correctly remains incomplete. This closes the current false-completeness path identified above.

NIT: any future change that populates CALLEE_TARGETS should also bind each diagnostic target to source location and stage invocation/capture identity; this delta intentionally does not claim or establish those future bindings.

validation.synthetic_audit_tests: PASS (2 tests; locally run, synthetic only)

followup_delta_review.limitations: This delta is acceptable as a fail-closed audit correction. It cannot produce a complete matrix while callee targets are empty and grants no proof, acceptance, or proof-credit claim. The original a804575 verdict remains NO_GO for that exact candidate.
